verdict.rationale: Omnara's GitHub README says organization and project roles can be assigned to API keys, separating who can manage access, configure agents, operate them, or only view them, which gives role-scoped, least-privilege credentials. The auth docs mention more than one key type, each sent as a bearer token. missing for 10: per-agent (rather than project-level) credential scoping, fine-grained permission or expiry controls, in-depth first-party docs on key scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
